principles.c4: I-Android engu-360 px, i-3G, izilimi ezine zokwethulwa.
principles.quote: Isendlalelo esithembekile, sesikhathi sangempela somsebenzi wase-South Africa.

faq.a1: USebenza uyiplatifomu kazwelonke yethalente yase-South Africa. Abafuni bomsebenzi bakha iphrofayela kanye futhi bangatholwa ngabaqashi abaqinisekisiwe kuzo zonke izifundazwe eziyisi-9. Abaqashi basesha amaphrofayela abukhoma, akalwa ngokusha, ngomsebenzi, ngesifundazwe nangamakhono. Iphethwe yi-Yetotec (Pty) Ltd futhi yakhiwe nge-POPIA kuqala.
faq.a2: Yebo. Ukwakha iphrofayela, ukutholwa, ukwamukela izimemo nokwamukela umsebenzi kumahhala kubafuni bomsebenzi. USebenza akayona i-ejensi yomsebenzi. Asilokothi sithathe imali emholweni wakho.
faq.a3: Abaqashi abaqinisekisiwe basesha ngomsebenzi, ngesifundazwe nangamakhono. Iphrofayela yakho yomphakathi ibonisa igama elifihliwe futhi ayilokothi ibonise imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana, inombolo kamazisi noma amadokhumenti. Umqashi ufinyelela kuwe kuphela ngeplatifomu, ngemvume yakho, futhi konke ukuvezwa kokuxhumana kurekhodwa kwilogu yokuhlola ongayibuka.
faq.q4: Ingabe ngidinga umatikuletsheni noma iziqu ukuze ngijoyine?
faq.a4: Cha. USebenza ungowawo wonke amazinga amakhono: kusukela kubasebenzi jikelele, ezingcweti nakubashayeli kuya kubaphothule nakochwepheshe. Abafundi bamanje bangabhalisa iphrofayela yomfundi nosuku lokuphothula olulindelekile. Okubalulekile yiphrofayela eneqiniso, hhayi isiqu esithile.
faq.q5: Ulwazi lwami lomuntu siqu luvikelwa kanjani?
faq.a5: USebenza wakhiwe ngokuzungeza i-POPIA, umthetho wase-South Africa wokuvikela idatha. Unikeza imvume ethile ngendlela ngayinye ulwazi lwakho olusetshenziswa ngayo, futhi ungamisa ukubonakala kwakho noma uhoxise imvume noma nini. Amasimu abucayi ayabethelwa, amakhasi omphakathi ayafihlwa, futhi konke ukufinyelela kulwazi lwakho kuyarekhodwa.
faq.a6: Ibheji lokuqinisekisa lisho ukuthi iplatifomu iqinisekise into ngempela, isibonelo umqashi eqinisekisa irekhodi lomsebenzi. Yonke iphrofayela iqala ithi “akuqinisekisiwe” futhi sikusho lokho ngobuqotho; amabheji awathengwa futhi awacatshangelwa. Izibalo zibala ukuqashwa kuphela uma kuqinisekisiwe ngeplatifomu.

Abafuni bomsebenzi bakha iphrofayela eyodwa yamahhala batholakale; abaqashi basesha ithalente elibukhoma eliqinisekiswe ngobuqotho; ukuqashwa okuqinisekisiwe kuba ulwazi lwangempela lwemakethe yezomsebenzi.

hero.lead: USebenza uwuhlu kazwelonke lwethalente olwakhiwe nge-POPIA kuqala. Abafuni bomsebenzi bakha iphrofayela eyodwa yamahhala batholakale. problem.item1: Ama-CV ayikhulu eqenjini le-WhatsApp, kungekho ndlela yokwazi ukuthi ubani ongowangempela.
problem.item2: Izinqolobane lapho uhhafu wabantu “abatholakalayo” bathola umsebenzi ezinyangeni ezedlule.
problem.item3: Amabheji athi kuqinisekisiwe kanti akekho oqinisekise lutho ngempela.
problem.item4: Abafuni bomsebenzi bekhokha ukuze babonakale, noma belahlekelwa yimali ngabaqashi bamanga.
problem.closeA: I-South Africa ayinakushoda kwethalente. Inokushoda kwesignali ethembekile.

who.heading: Uhlu olulodwa, izinhlangothi ezintathu
who.seekersBody: Yakha iphrofayela eyodwa: amakhono akho, isipiliyoni, ukutholakala, nalapho ukhona. Tholwa ngabaqashi abaqinisekisiwe, menywe ezikhundleni zangempela ezinamagama, faka isicelo ngezixhumanisi zomphakathi zezikhala, futhi ulawule lonke ulwazi lwakho ngaphansi kwe-POPIA. Kusukela kubasebenzi jikelele nezingcweti kuya kubaphothule nakochwepheshe. Nabafundi futhi.
who.employersBody: Sesha ngekhono, ngendawo nangokutholakala, hhayi ngenhlanhla. Bona izimo zokuqinisekiswa eziqotho nokuthi iphrofayela ngayinye isha kangakanani. Phatha izikhala: hlanganisa abantu ngokubuyela emuva, bameme ezikhundleni ezinamagama, wabelane ngesixhumanisi sokufaka isicelo ku-WhatsApp, futhi urekhode ukuqashwa uma kwenzeka.
who.governmentBody: Iphothali yezibalo efundwa kuphela, enomkhawulo wobumfihlo: lapho isidingo sikhona, lapho ukutholakala kukhona, kungani izikhundla zingagcwaliswa, kungani abafundi bebambeka, nokuthi ikharikhulamu ihambisana kanjani nemakethe. Zonke izibalo zi-k-anonymised futhi zihlanganisiwe. Akulokothi kube umuntu obonakalayo.

difference.heading: Ubuqotho buyisici
difference.b1: Ibheji lithi kuqinisekisiwe kuphela uma kukhona okuqinisekisiwe ngempela. Asilokothi sihlobise idatha ezibikelwe.
difference.b2: Sonke isimo somsebenzi sinosuku lokuqinisekiswa. Amaphrofayela amadala ehla ohlwini ngobuqotho esikhundleni sokuchitha izingcingo zakho.
difference.b3: Izibalo zethu zokubekwa zirekhodwa ngeplatifomu, azilokothi zizibikelwe kwispredishithi.
difference.b4: Azikho izinombolo zomazisi, awekho amadokhumenti, ayikho imininingwane yokuxhumana ekusesheni. Ukuxhumana kuvezwa kuphela kubaqashi abaqinisekisiwe, ngemvume, futhi konke ukuvezwa kurekhodwa lapho umfuni womsebenzi angakubona khona.
difference.b5: Abantu bahlanganiswa ngalapho bekhona nangalokho abangakwenza. Ubuzwe buyaboniswa, abulokothi bube yisango.

how.heading: Iluphu eyodwa, kusukela kwiphrofayela kuya kwinqubomgomo
how.lead: Ukuqasha kuwumkhiqizo. Izibalo ziphuma kukho ngobuqotho.
how.s1b: Amakhono, isipiliyoni, ukutholakala, indawo. Mahhala, ngezilimi ezine, kunoma iyiphi ifoni.
how.s2b: Izihlungi ezibukhoma ngekhono, ngesifundazwe nangokutholakala, noma ukuhlanganisa okubuyela emuva esikhaleni esithile.
how.s3b: Umqashi umema umfuni womsebenzi esikhundleni esinegama, noma abelane ngesixhumanisi somphakathi se-Self Apply sesikhala noma kuphi, kubandakanya i-WhatsApp, abafuni bomsebenzi bangene ngokwabo.
how.s4b: Abaqashi abaqinisekisiwe kuphela. Kuhlolwa njalo. Umfuni womsebenzi uyabona ukuthi ubani omfinyelele.
how.s5b: Kurekhodwa ngeplatifomu, ngakho kubalwa kanye futhi kubalwa ngeqiniso.
how.s6b: Ukuqashwa okuqinisekisiwe kuhlanganiswa ezibalweni ezi-k-anonymised: isidingo, ukutholakala, ukushoda, imiphumela. Kubukhoma, hhayi okonyaka odlule.

proof.heading: Sincamela ukukubonisa izibalo ezibukhoma
proof.lead: Lezi zibalo zivela ngqo kuhlu ngomzuzu ovula ngawo leli khasi. Ziyizibalo ezifanayo amadeshibhodi ethu asebenza ngazo. Zikalwa ngokusha, azilokothi zikhukhunyezwe.
proof.honest: USebenza usemusha futhi ngeke sizenze sengathi akunjalo. Asiqambi izilinganiso zezinkanyezi ezinhlanu: njengoba abantu bangempela nabaqashi besho izinto zangempela, amazwi abo avela lapha namagama abo, futhi ngemvume yabo kuphela.
proof.promise1: Kumahhala kubafuni bomsebenzi. Azikho izimali, nanini, futhi akukho ukukhokha ukuze ukhuphuke.
proof.promise2: I-POPIA kuqala kusukela emgqeni wokuqala wekhodi: imvume ehlukanisiwe, ukubethelwa kwamasimu, ilogu yokuhlola engunaphakade, ukukhipha nokusula kwakhelwe ngaphakathi.
proof.promise3: Amabheji aqotho, ukusha okuqotho, izibalo zokubekwa eziqotho. Uhlu luncamela ukubukeka luncane kunokuqamba amanga.
proof.promise4: Yakhelwe i-South Africa yangempela: i-Android ephansi ku-3G iyidivayisi yethu yereferensi, izilimi ezine zokwethulwa, iyafakwa njengohlelo lokusebenza.

why.heading: Kungani uSebenza, hhayi elinye ibhodi lemisebenzi
why.b1: Amabhodi emisebenzi afaka izikhangiso. USebenza ugcina uhlu oluphilayo, olukalwa ngokusha lwabantu, futhi izikhundla ziza kubo.
why.b2: Izimo zokuqinisekiswa, amasango emvume, ukuvezwa okuhlolwayo nokufihlwa kuphoqelelwa ngekhodi, kukho konke ukufundwa.
why.b3: Ngoba ukuqashwa kuqinisekiswa kuplatifomu, isithombe esihlanganisiwe singesangempela: izignali zokushoda ezibukhoma, imiphumela yokubekwa, ikharikhulamu eqhathaniswa nesidingo. Konke ku-k-anonymised.
why.b4: Abaqashi badonsa ngokusesha nangezimemo; abafuni bomsebenzi bangena ngezixhumanisi zomphakathi ze-Self Apply ezabiwe noma kuphi. Ipayipi elilodwa, elimakwe ngobuqotho.
why.b5: Abafuni bomsebenzi bangamisa ukubonakala, bavimbe umqashi, bakhiphe konke, noma bazisule. Imvume ingeyenjongo ngayinye, akulokothi kube yibhokisi elilodwa elivumela konke.

pricing.heading: Kumahhala kubafuni bomsebenzi. Kulula kwabanye bonke.
pricing.lead: Uhlu lukazwelonke lusebenza kuphela uma wonke umuntu wase-South Africa ekwazi ukuba kulo, ngakho uhlangothi lomfuni womsebenzi lumahhala, unomphela. Ubambiswano lwabaqashi nohulumeni lubizwa ngokobukhulu bethimba nemibiko abayidingayo.

finalCta.heading: Zibonele uhlu ngokwakho.
finalCta.lead: Sesha njengomvakashi, joyina njengomfuni womsebenzi, noma usibhalele sikuhambise ohlangothini lwabaqashi nolwezibalo ngokwesimo sakho. Akukho ukucindezela, akukho ulimi olunzima.
